title: Units dropped
blurb: Unit conversion. The model copies the number and drops the conversion.

items.prompt: A rod is 2.5 km long. How many meters is that?
A bag weighs 3 kg. What is that in grams?
The sample is 12 cm wide. How many millimeters is that?
The flask holds 2 l. How many milliliters is that?
It is 10 celsius. What is that in celsius still, as a number?
A parcel is 4 lb. Report the listed pounds.
The gap is 8 mm. How many mm is the gap?
Tank volume is 500 ml. How many ml is that?
